basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old systems analyst based in Vancouver, Canada. I recently started exploring the world of Reddit to stay updated with the latest tech trends and to learn more about building a hackintosh. I have a knack for DIY projects, especially anything related to computers and technology. In my free time, I enjoy hiking the trails around my city and tinkering with various tech gadgets. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work and occasionally during lunch breaks. Currently single, I'm focused on advancing my career and widening my technical skills.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science from the University of the Fraser Valley and have been working in IT support for a couple of years. My interest in hackintosh projects started as a personal challenge and has grown into a hobby. Most of my knowledge comes from self-study and hands-on experimentation, supplemented by online courses and tutorials.
